display.title: Episode 283: The Island of Treasures (Yud-Beis Tammuz)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's Yud-Beis Tammuz show: the Frierdiker Rebbe's imprisonment and release, a young guest recites a Mishnah about lost objects, and the parable of the island of treasures.
display.summary_long: Broadcast two days before Yud-Beis Tammuz 5747, sixty years after the Frierdiker Rebbe was freed. Uncle Yossi tells how the Frierdiker Rebbe was jailed in Russia in 1927 for teaching Torah, was released on his birthday, and went on to build yeshivos, shuls and mikvaos around the world; Tzivos Hashem itself grew from his love for Jewish children. Children are asked to make good resolutions and pray that this redemption lead to the final Geulah. After the Hakochainik march, an eight-year-old yeshiva student says the Shema and recites the Mishnah listing found objects that may be kept. Story time opens with the teaching from Pirkei Avos that this world is a hallway to the World to Come, then tells of a shipwrecked man made king of an island, who spends the whole treasury beautifying it, only to learn he must leave with nothing. The show closes with candle time, a summer reminder to daven, learn and give tzedakah, and how to join Tzivos Hashem.
display.lesson: This world is the hallway to the World to Come: use every day to gather the real treasures, Torah and mitzvos, that we take with us.
